classes: About page: mission, story, values, team or founder note, milestones, and contact invitation.
Bakery site: menu, daily specials, story, hours, location, gallery, and an order or contact action.
Blog layout: narrow text column, clear headings, generous spacing, author line, and related reading links.
Booking flow: choose service, pick time, enter details, confirm, and show cancellation terms clearly.
Case study: problem, constraints, approach, result, evidence, and lessons learned.
Category page: filters, sort, product cards, stock state, and clear prices.
Changelog: date, version, changes grouped by type, and links to related guides.
Checkout flow: cart summary, details, payment step, review, confirmation, and clear error recovery.
Comparison page: shared criteria, honest trade-offs, best-for notes, and a recommendation by use case.
Contact page: short form, direct email, response time, location if relevant, and privacy note.
Course site: outcomes, curriculum, instructor, schedule, pricing, sample lesson, and enrollment action.
Dark theme site: deep background, high-contrast text, one accent colour, and image panels that keep detail visible on dark surfaces.
Dashboard overview: key metrics first, recent activity, alerts, charts, and shortcuts to common actions.
Documentation navigation: start guide, concepts, tutorials, reference, search, and version notes.
Empty state: say nothing matched, suggest spelling or filters to change, and offer a reset action.
Error state: explain what failed, keep entered data, highlight the field, and offer a safe retry.
Event page: date, venue, agenda, speakers, tickets, travel notes, and updates section.
FAQ page: group questions by topic, keep answers short, and link to contact help when needed.
Feature grid: six focused features, short descriptions, consistent icons, and links to deeper pages.
Footer: contact, key pages, legal links, social links, and a short site summary.
Forum homepage: categories, active discussions, rules, search, and a clear new topic action.
Gallery layout: consistent image sizes, captions, filters, and a lightbox that works with keyboard controls.
Help center: search first, popular topics, guides by task, status link, and contact support action.
Hero section: one promise, one supporting sentence, one primary action, and visual proof.
Landing page plan: clear hero, proof of work, services, process, testimonial space, and one contact action, with home, about and contact pages.
Landing page plan: clear hero, proof of work, services, process, testimonial space, and one contact action.
Lesson page: objective, video or text, practice task, recap, and next lesson link.
Local business site: services, service area, reviews, hours, photos, and call action.
Location section: address, map, transit notes, parking notes, and opening hours.
Login page: email and password fields, recovery link, error message area, and secure submit action.
Membership flow: benefits, plans, signup, member area, renewal reminders, and cancellation path.
Mobile first: primary action near the top, readable type, large touch targets, and content in priority order.
Multi-language structure: language switcher, translated navigation, locale-aware dates, and fallback text rules.
Newsletter section: clear benefit, one email field, privacy note, and a success message after signup.
Nonprofit homepage: mission, impact numbers, stories, ways to help, transparency links, and donation action.
Photographer portfolio: full-bleed gallery, selected series, about page, services and rates, and a booking contact action.
Podcast site: latest episode, episode archive, about the show, host bio, and subscribe links.
Portfolio home: strong intro, selected projects, skills, short biography, and a simple contact section.
Pricing table: align features by row, highlight the recommended plan, and state limits without fine print.
Privacy page: data collected, purpose, retention, sharing, user rights, and contact method.
Product page: benefit headline, feature list, pricing choices, comparison notes, and a clear purchase action.
Profile page: identity header, about text, activity, settings shortcut, and privacy controls.
Progress indicator: thin bar tied to scroll position, visible but not distracting, with reduced-motion respect.
Restaurant site: menu with prices, daily specials, story, hours and location, gallery, and a reservation or contact action.
Restaurant site: menu, story, hours, location, gallery, reservations, and contact details.
Resume site: summary, experience, projects, skills, education, and downloadable resume link.
Search results: query summary, filters, result cards, empty state, and sort controls.
Settings page: group related controls, label every field, show save state, and confirm destructive actions.
Shoe store: product grid with sizes and prices, filters by size and style, cart and checkout pages, and clear delivery and return notes.
Signup form: ask only essentials, explain why each field is needed, and validate kindly.
Sticky navigation: keep key links visible, avoid covering content, and collapse cleanly on small screens.
Terms page: service scope, user duties, payments, limits, changes, and contact method.
Testimonial section: short quotes, names or roles, star context if used, and no invented claims.
Wedding site: story, schedule, venue, travel, registry, and RSVP form.
